name: znetwork_dplay_send_reliable
description: zNetworkDPlay::SendReliable forwards a packet to DirectPlay Send with reliable flags and reports negative HRESULT failures.
known_limits: The smoke uses a fake DirectPlay provider for reliable send behavior and one negative HRESULT path; tier S verification is deferred to a zNetwork source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48ad30 validates DirectPlay Send slot 0x68, local-player source key, reliable flag 1, packet-size argument, and zNetwork_DPlay::ReportError on negative HRESULT.
The native zNetwork packet-send smoke verifies reliable Send parameters and negative-HRESULT handling through the public wrapper.
